entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Akötesie ti fe, nyipici koti ni laka Cilie la Atre ipi ni matre troni a adraje hne, fni a öhne hnyawa enehila laka Atre ka kucakuca ni, nge thei Cilie la egöcatr. Atre ka pé mo ni, nge Cilie la trenamo.

Nyipici, pékö eatre Akötesie hui Enétilai Joxu, la Atre i xatua ngöne la ijine hace, la Atre ka cilehuti epinéti palua.
